1.consolidated_definition: Dícese de la persona que quiere hacer las cosas precipitadamente, antes del tiempo oportuno.
1.en_consolidated_definition:
This is said of a person who wants to do things hastily, before the opportune time.

Alternatively:

One describes as someone who wishes to accomplish things precipitously, prior to the proper moment.

Or more formally:

Described as an individual who desires to undertake tasks in a hasty manner, preceding the suitable occasion.
